name: Inslope wallbounce: a superbounce off a slope's face
techNote: A moss slope rising 400 over 60 (81.5 degrees; x 0-60) on a moss floor, the finish box floating over its top (y 560-640). The start falls past the slope's foot at 460 u/s with one dash and no wall jumps (wallJumpsLeft -1, maxWallJumps 0; moss refills nothing, so no final cling either). Dash right with the jump on dash frame 1: the dash runs its hitbox's corner into the face, the level wall rays hit the face, and the wall branch ends the dash with the jump buffered inside dashBoostMax: the superbounce off the slope on tick 4 (Velocity (-276, 703), momentum.y 400.8), over the slope's top into the box (finish tick 26). Ghosts: `no-jump` (the same dash without the jump: clings to the face and slides down), `super` (the dash two inputs later grounds on the face first: a super, peak 507, under the box) and `jump` (no dash, a ground jump off the face: peak 475).

ghosts.label: The same dash without the jump: clings to the face
Dash two ticks later: grounds on the face, a super
No dash: a ground jump off the face
